scope: Cloud-flow product capabilities in the supplied documentation snapshot. For each operation assess the behavior in its own scope. Default and effective tenant configuration are distinct questions.
assertion_fields: Include product typing, all eight roster ownership links, exactly one behavior class per operation, and each evidence-supported relation or aspect from the candidate lists. Use the scope labels in the review.

operations.label: Copilot cloud-flow authoring
operations.scope: Create the structure of a new cloud flow from a natural-language description. This operation concerns the author's design experience.

operations.label: Copilot expression authoring
operations.scope: Create, update, or fix a flow expression in the expression editor using the named Copilot expression assistant.

operations.label: Filter array
operations.scope: Apply the Filter array data operation to a supplied array and a configured filter criterion.

operations.label: Join
operations.scope: Apply the Join data operation to a supplied array and a configured separator.

operations.label: Select
operations.scope: Apply the Select data operation to a supplied array with a configured field projection.

operations.label: Trigger condition evaluation
operations.scope: Evaluate an already-configured trigger condition to decide whether a cloud-flow run starts. The condition can have been authored by any supported route.

operations.label: Flow Checker diagnosis
operations.scope: Identify errors, warnings, or improvement guidance using the Flow Checker design-time feedback surface. Consider the mechanism that performs the diagnosis.

operations.label: Operation through a custom connector
operations.scope: Assess whether the selected organization-owned service operation called from a cloud flow through a configured custom connector uses an AI model. The supplied sources describe the Power Automate integration surface.

review_scope: Identify the open mechanism question for each unclassified operation. Address direction and use scope for the condition-expression relationship and distinguish documented tenant controls from an organization's effective configuration.
